text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: How was that just now, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, "not bad", huh... It feels like 
something's missing—

The moment Tokai Teio said that, all the 
strength suddenly left her body—
(Whooooosh~~――)
(Woooooah——!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? Why am I out on the track...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Teioooo!! Keep it up all the 
wayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Teio's so super cool~~~!! Do your 
best~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Could it be you're all my 
fans...!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~ I see, I see~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"If you're cheering me on that much, I'm 
gonna give it everything I've got!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Here goes――

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Behold Lord Teio's prized 'Teio Step'!!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOAAAHH—!!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you everyone for cheer... 
ing... me on...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh...? A dream?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Looks like I was dreaming.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, it was such an awesome dream. 
Everyone was cheering for me—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Ah, that's it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Got it! The thing I'm missing right now! 
It's cheering! Cheering!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer, cheer for me a whoooole 
bunch!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then you'll surely get just as much power 
as in your dream!

Afterward, when I cheered for Tokai Teio, 
her running became noticeably lighter on 
its feet than usual.
